messages:
maria.gonzalez: fyi i'm scheduling a zero-trust rollback drill for a private deploy this Fri 10:00 UTC. goal: verify RBAC step-down, KMS failover, and audit log integrity under a simulated configuration rollback. :eyes:
cheng.li: sounds good. what scope are we targeting? single-tenant onprem cluster or full VPC?
alex.k: single onprem cluster first, then a scoped VPC test if the first pass is clean. keep blast radius small.
jordan: for RBAC, do we want a simulated role-revocation where controllers lose write to secrets? i can craft a short-lived policy change and a canary pod to detect failures.
maria.gonzalez: yes — revoke secret write on the serving-ns service account for 2 minutes, then restore. we should validate autoscaling and graceful degradation.
cheng.li: KMS side: i'll rotate a staging key to a new version and trigger decryption against the old key to ensure decrypt fails as expected, then perform a KMS failover to secondary key. note: onprem uses our HSM shim, so we need ops-oncall there.
ops-oncall: i'll be on-call. for the HSM path we'll run the rotation in maintenance window and capture logs from the HSM gateway. can you list the exact commands you want?
jordan: plan to run these probes: `kubectl exec canary -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health || echo FAIL` and `kubectl auth can-i update secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:serving-ns:canary` to verify RBAC. i'll post the playbook in the runbook link.
sec-bot: reminder: enable audit-policy v2 for the cluster for the duration of the test. retention set to 30d and export to internal-s3-audit.
cheng.li: also capture network flow logs (calico/falco) to ensure netpols are enforced during rollback. propose enabling policy-block list for egress to external IPs except jumpbox during the test.
alex.k: to minimize noise, create a dedicated test label `zero-trust-drill=true` so rollout traces and metrics can be filtered.
maria.gonzalez: incident response exercise: simulate a failed restore where KMS returns 403 for decrypt calls. ops-oncall will trigger the DR runbook, SRE will observe failover to cached payloads. record the timeline.
ops-oncall: noted. i'll run a manual failover script: `./hsm-failover --target secondary --dry-run` then actual. will capture timestamps.
cheng.li: after the drill, we need a short postmortem: did logs include consistent request ids, were audit entries immutable, any tenant bleed? assign owners and open issues.
jordan: i'll own RBAC artifact and playbook updates. alex.k will own canary dashboard filters. maria will own coordinating postmortem.
maria.gonzalez: ok thanks. final checklist to validate during test: 1) RBAC enforcement observed via `kubectl auth can-i`, 2) KMS rotation + failover logs, 3) audit logs present and exported, 4) netpol egress block effective, 5) no data leaks to external IPs. anyone else? :thumbsup:
alex.k: +1. i'll add the dashboard panels and synthetic checks.
sec-bot: scheduled maintenance window created: Fri 10:00-11:00 UTC. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/zero-trust-rollback-drill (ops access only)
maria.gonzalez: perfect. we'll run a short tabletop at 09:30 UTC to walk through steps. thanks all.
